version.description: Semver of this export's shape. Bump on breaking changes to existing fields; adding new fields does not require a bump.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp of when this export was built.

permalink.description: Absolute URL of the app's page.

author.description: Author display name. Empty string if unset.

author_url.description: Link to the author's profile/site. Empty string if unset.

date_added.description: Date the app was added, as written in front matter (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty string if unset.

category.description: App category, e.g. "Utility". Empty string if unset.

description.description: Short summary: front-matter description, or an auto-generated summary of the content if omitted.

content.description: Full plain-text body of the app's page (front matter stripped, markdown rendered to plain text).

repo.description: Source repository URL. Empty string if unset.

download.description: Download/releases URL. Empty string if unset.

badges.description: Badge/flag identifiers that apply to this app, e.g. "light_sdk", "light_approved", "editor_pick". New badge types may appear here over time without a schema change; unrecognized values should be ignored, not treated as errors.

latest_release.description: Latest GitHub release info, derived from `repo`. All fields are empty strings if no repo is set or no release was found.

url.description: Link to the release on GitHub.

images.description: Absolute URLs of the app's screenshots, in front-matter order.

videos.description: Absolute URLs of the app's video clips, in front-matter order.
